mapper.select: select s.id session_id,s.user_id,sq.question_order,s.status session_status, sq.presentation_snapshot::text,sq.grading_snapshot::text,sq.knowledge_snapshot::text, a.id attempt_id,aa.answer_data::text, case when aa.score_rate is null then null else aa.score_rate=1 end correct from cm_learning_session s join cm_session_question sq on sq.session_id=s.id left join cm_question_attempt a on a.session_question_id=sq.id and a.user_id=s.user_id and a.status='submitted' left join cm_attempt_answer aa on aa.attempt_id=a.id where s.id=#{sessionId} and s.user_id=#{userId} and s.session_type in ('self_practice','reinforcement_practice') and sq.question_order=#{questionOrder}
mapper.sql: c.id,c.user_id,c.practice_session_id,c.question_order,c.status,c.provider,c.model_name, c.create_time,c.update_time, (select m.id from cm_ai_message m where m.conversation_id=c.id and m.role='ASSISTANT' and m.status='GENERATING' order by m.sequence_no desc limit 1) generating_assistant_message_id
mapper.select: select from cm_ai_conversation c where c.user_id=#{userId} and c.practice_session_id=#{sessionId} and c.question_order=#{questionOrder}
select from cm_ai_conversation c where c.id=#{conversationId} and c.user_id=#{userId}

select c.id,c.user_id,c.practice_session_id,c.question_order,c.status,c.provider,c.model_name, c.create_time,c.update_time from cm_ai_conversation c where c.id=#{conversationId} and c.user_id=#{userId} for update
mapper.insert: insert into cm_ai_conversation(id,user_id,practice_session_id,question_order,status,provider,model_name) values(#{id},#{userId},#{sessionId},#{questionOrder},'ACTIVE',#{provider},#{modelName}) on conflict (user_id,practice_session_id,question_order) do nothing
mapper.select: select count(*)::int from cm_ai_message where conversation_id=#{conversationId}

select id,conversation_id,reply_to_message_id,sequence_no,role,content,status, answer_disclosure_mode,error_code,client_message_id,citations::text as citations,create_time,completed_time from cm_ai_message where client_message_id=#{clientMessageId} and role='USER'

select id,conversation_id,reply_to_message_id,sequence_no,role,content,status, answer_disclosure_mode,error_code,client_message_id,citations::text as citations,create_time,completed_time from cm_ai_message where reply_to_message_id=#{userMessageId} and role='ASSISTANT'

select m.id,m.conversation_id,m.reply_to_message_id,m.sequence_no,m.role,m.content,m.status, m.answer_disclosure_mode,m.error_code,m.client_message_id,m.citations::text as citations,m.create_time,m.completed_time from cm_ai_message m join cm_ai_conversation c on c.id=m.conversation_id where m.id=#{messageId} and m.conversation_id=#{conversationId} and m.role='ASSISTANT' and c.user_id=#{userId}
mapper.insert: insert into cm_ai_message(id,conversation_id,sequence_no,role,content,status,client_message_id,completed_time) values(#{id},#{conversationId},#{sequence},'USER',#{content},'COMPLETED',#{clientMessageId},now()) on conflict do nothing

insert into cm_ai_message(id,conversation_id,reply_to_message_id,sequence_no,role,content,status,answer_disclosure_mode) values(#{id},#{conversationId},#{userMessageId},#{sequence},'ASSISTANT','','GENERATING',#{disclosureMode}) on conflict do nothing
mapper.update: update cm_ai_message set content=#{content},citations=cast(#{citations} as jsonb),status='COMPLETED',error_code=null,completed_time=now() where id=#{id} and status='GENERATING'
update cm_ai_message set content='',status='FAILED',error_code=#{errorCode},completed_time=now() where id=#{id} and status='GENERATING'
update cm_ai_message set content='',status='CANCELLED',error_code=null,completed_time=now() where id=#{id} and status='GENERATING'
mapper.select: select m.id,m.conversation_id,m.reply_to_message_id,m.sequence_no,m.role,m.content,m.status, m.answer_disclosure_mode,m.error_code,m.client_message_id,m.citations::text as citations,m.create_time,m.completed_time, c.user_id owner_user_id from cm_ai_message m join cm_ai_conversation c on c.id=m.conversation_id where m.status='GENERATING' and m.create_time < now()-(#{seconds} * interval '1 second')
mapper.update: update cm_ai_message set content='',status='FAILED',error_code=#{errorCode},completed_time=now() where id=#{id} and status='GENERATING'
mapper.select: select id,payload_hash,status,resource_id,response_body::text from cm_idempotency_record where action_code=#{actionCode} and request_id=#{requestId}
mapper.insert: insert into cm_idempotency_record(id,action_code,request_id,payload_hash,status,expires_time) values(#{id},#{actionCode},#{requestId},#{payloadHash},'processing',now()+interval '24 hours') on conflict do nothing
mapper.update: update cm_idempotency_record set status='succeeded',resource_type=#{resourceType},resource_id=#{resourceId}, response_status=200,response_body=#{responseBody}::jsonb,update_time=now() where id=#{id} and status='processing'
